## 1 · The offer

Accounts payable software for mid-sized distributors. Pricing: a flat monthly fee per entity.

## 2 · Customer qualification & fit

Finance teams of two to ten people at distributors with several legal entities.

Not a fit: companies with fewer than 200 invoices a month.

## 3 · Customer problem & impact

Invoices arrive faster than the team can code and approve them.

## 4 · Buying triggers & timing

Trigger: month-end close slipped twice in a row.

Why now: e-invoicing rules take effect next year.
